title.question: How do you want to build your dashboard?

instruction.single_option: Describe what you want to monitor and the assistant will build a dashboard for you.
instruction.multi_option: Both paths create a full SQL-backed dashboard without writing queries. Choose the approach that fits how you think: question-first or template-first.

ai_assistant.title: AI Assistant
ai_assistant.sublabel: From a plain-language description to a working dashboard
ai_assistant.paragraph: Describe what you want to monitor in plain language. The assistant will ask a few clarifying questions and build a full SQL-backed dashboard that you can preview against your own data before it's added to your sidebar.

best_for.paragraph: You know what you want to see but not which tables or queries it takes to get there.

interview_item.list_item: Plain-language interview. Refine the result by continuing the conversation.

preview_item.list_item: Preview every panel against your real data before it becomes a dashboard.

section_item.list_item: Saved into the "AI Dashboards" section in your sidebar.
